title: NoiseQA: Challenge Set Evaluation for User-Centric Question Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating downstream Question Answering performance disparities when spoken queries are processed through an ASR pipeline using Text-to-Speech voices with different regional accents (Australian, British, Indian, and US) as well as human speakers with diverse accents.
Comparing the performance of the ASR-QA pipeline on spoken queries generated using male versus female synthetic voices.

Measuring the degradation in Question Answering performance when queries are machine-translated into English from 10 different source languages, specifically analyzing the performance gap between high-resource and lower-resource/typologically distant languages.
